title: Quantum Magic Reveals CP Phases Invisible to Entanglement in Spin-0 Decays
summary: All standard scalar quantum-information measures -- concurrence, negativity, entanglement entropy, the optimized CHSH bound, and quantum Fisher information -- are CP-blind in ideal \\ spin-0 $\to f\bar f$ decays because the two-qubit spin state is maximally entangled for every CP angle. We show that stabilizer magic, fixed in the physical Pauli frame of spin analysis, escapes this blind spot: the stabilizer Rényi entropy admits an exact closed form, vanishing at CP-definite and Clifford phases and peaking at maximal non-Clifford mixing.
